metadata.sql: SELECT driver_code, driver_name, constructor, position, year, grand_prix FROM v_race_results WHERE year = 2021 AND ((lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil') OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR (lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(circuit_country) = 'brazil')) AND position = 1
metadata.chart_title: Who won the 2021 Brazilian Grand Prix?
